items.title: Land surveying
items.text: The firm's core work: professional land surveying.

sections.title: A North Augusta *survey firm*
body: John M. Bailey & Associates has practiced professional land surveying from North Augusta since 1985. John M. Bailey is the firm's president.
The firm is registered in the federal government's vendor system for surveying and mapping services, and is a member of the North Augusta Chamber of Commerce.

items.a: No. Some directories list the firm under attorneys, but John M. Bailey & Associates is a firm of professional land surveyors.

items.q: How do I get a quote for a survey?
items.a: Call (803) 278-0721 with the property address and what the survey is for.

sections.title: Need a survey?
sections.text: Call the office on LeCompte Avenue.

before: No website of its own: a search turns up directory pages
Some of those directories list the firm under attorneys, and one describes it as a law firm
The first thing a new client sees is not something the firm controls
after: A site the firm owns, that says plainly what it does
Phone, address and map in one obvious place
Room for survey types, sample plats and a quote request as the firm supplies them
A proper preview when the link is shared by email or text
